staticLint.classification: File-local heuristics miss shared Action/controlClass focus/hover and treat mapped select options as a loading list. Form is mounted with directory data, has explicit Unassigned option and disabled fields. Actual creation/draft/cancel and empty search pass. No new defect established by these flags.

busy/setBusy plus disabled and saving copy implement request feedback but regex searches loading/pending. Directory loading is in workspace parent. Source evidence only for privileged member-management mutations; this reviewer did not replay all owner administration UI.

measurementLimits: Canvas rounds channels to8-bit sRGB; broad margins required and all reported contrast failures are below threshold before any rounding-to-pass.

Raw collector includes sr-only direct text because checkVisibility does not account for clip-path; named controls count is not visible-focus proof. Search tab stop independently checked with geometry and settled screenshot.
Snapshots alone do not certify all screen reader behavior, native OS focus or performance.
